title: A Bald Eagle Nest Weighed Over Two Tons

scenes.text: One bald eagle nest weighed more than two tons.
scenes.keywords: giant bird nest tree bald eagle

scenes.text: It sat in a tree near St. Petersburg, Florida, and was studied in 1963.
It was nearly ten feet wide and twenty feet deep.
scenes.keywords: tall tree nest eagle looking down

scenes.text: That's about 4,400 pounds of sticks, grass, and mud.
Eagles don't build a new nest. They return and add more every single year.
Eventually, the tree holds a house made of twigs.

description:
The largest bird nest ever recorded was built by bald eagles near St. Petersburg, Florida.
It was about 9.5 feet wide, 20 feet deep and weighed more than two tonnes, roughly 4,400 pounds.
How big is the biggest bird nest you've ever seen?
thumbnail_text: AN EAGLE NEST THAT WEIGHED 2 TONS
first_comment: Bonus: bald eagles keep adding to the same nest year after year, which is how it gets this huge. Would you want that nest in your tree?
